finding: Deferred top-k used an unadmitted selector and output branch for borrowed vector scanners. Mutable binary winner payloads could also alias scanner buffers after iteration.
changes: Use OwnedBoundedTopK for both owned and borrowed vector scanners; remove duplicate addRankedRefs path.
Admit predicate workspace, selected-reference ordering, deferred row directories and final projection for borrowed scanners.
Materialize borrowed selected rows through a scoped shape plan and detach mutable data before the scanner advances.
Enable explicit owned deferred output for borrowed vector scanners; unsupported owned routes still fall back safely.

cases: Plain and explicitly owned deferred output preserve binary values when scanner overwrites its source after yield.
Both APIs succeed at observed allocation peak and reject one byte below it.
Rank-only first read and payload-only winner read are asserted.

limits: Controlled borrowed scanner fixture, not cloud latency evidence.
Borrowed scanner source allocations occur outside query admission; copied library-retained data is admitted.
Rank-column planning and other allocation categories still require audit; this does not close all F3/M1 requirements.
Detaching borrowed values adds copy work; no performance-speedup claim is made.
